annotations.limits: supply-side signals, not a load-interconnection promise — generation is not deliverable load · utility study timelines, large-load tariff processes and substation-grain delivery are declared out of coverage rather than estimated · the queue feed carries no delivery dates, and most queued MW never completes — queue depth is congestion context, not a timeline
annotations.problem: grid headroom and power availability; interconnection queues

description: Use this when the user asks about grid interconnection queues: how congested an ISO's queue is or how much data-center load is waiting. Returns queued generation GW per ISO. The projects field changes shape: with iso= it is an array of per-project rows; without iso it is an all-ISO summary object (total, by_iso_count, top). ERCOT also returns its large-load (data-center) queue; other ISOs don't publish one. Keyless: a trimmed preview; free with an email-bound key. Ex: "How deep is ERCOT's queue?" iso optional (US ISO code); free = preview. For demand and headroom on the same ISO also call get_grid_intelligence.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region to drill into: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE; omit for the all-ISO snapshot
